howToRead.source: AgentPod's execution corpora (packages/contract/src/fixtures/execution-{export,evidence,artifacts}-v1.json, version 1), moved here as cases: each `success` row is a valid case and each `rejection` row an invalid one, under the row's `name`.
howToRead.schemas: schemas.<name> holds the cases of schemas/agentpod/<name>.json.
howToRead.parity: AgentPod's zod refuses some values a JSON Schema cannot (its refinements); every invalid case here is one the schema refuses too.
